psychological_meaning: Bastille, a deep and muted purplish-gray, evokes a sense of sophistication, mystery, and quiet strength. It suggests introspection and a touch of melancholy, often associated with resilience and a refined sensibility. This color can also represent stability and groundedness, tempered with an underlying hint of the unconventional.
